newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan construction firms up on buy-backs.
newsitem.headline: Japan construction firms up on buy-backs.

text.p: Shares of Japanese construction firms climbed in early Monday morning trade because of buy-backs, brokers said.

By 0051 GMT, Tobishima Corp's shares had climbed 17 yen to 205, becoming the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse. Aoki Corp, up 10 yen at 163, ranked second. Tokyu Construction Co Ltd was up two yen at 240.

"After shares were sold ahead of the end-March corporate book closings, we are seeing less downward potential (for construction shares) and this helped prompt some buying back," an official at a medium-sized brokerage said.
But other traders said that the upward potential would also be limited, as few investors want to bid them up further.
